title: Fire Protection — Aft Cargo Compartment — Relocate the Smoke Sampling Ports and Install the Shielded Inlets
abstract: Moves the two aft hold smoke sampling ports out of the door loading air path and fits shielded inlets with a labyrinth drain, on aircraft delivered before the production cut-in.

sections.planning_reason: Nineteen smoke detection events across seven operators were investigated with no source found, all within four hours of loading in rain, wet snow or high humidity. The sampling ports as delivered sit in the air path through the cargo door aperture, and condensation on the sampling tube wall scatters light in the same way as a low density smoke. Each event costs the operator a hold inspection and, in three cases, a diversion.
sections.description: This bulletin moves the two aft hold sampling ports inboard by three hundred and twenty millimetres and rotates them so that the inlet faces aft, and replaces the open port with a shielded inlet carrying a labyrinth drain. The sampling tube is re-clipped along the existing ceiling rail. The detection regulator, its sensitivity and the extinguishing system are unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove the aft hold ceiling lining panels at the two port positions and put the safety barriers in place. Disconnect the sampling tube at each port, remove the open port and blank the vacated hole with the supplied plug. Install the shielded inlet at the new position using the supplied screws in the existing ceiling rail holes, then re-route and re-clip the sampling tube with the supplied clamps. Do a flow check at each port and confirm the drain is clear. Do the smoke detection functional test in AMM-M-26-10-12-200-033-A using the smoke generator at both ports. Refit the lining panels, update the parts catalogue effectivity record and make the aircraft records entry.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00022 and M00290, excluding MSN M00263 which was delivered with the post modification standard as a customer option. The inspection bulletin MRD-26-1019 must have been accomplished first so that the ceiling rail condition is known.
sections.material_note: Kit contains two shielded inlets, two blanking plugs, the clamp set and the pan head screws. The removed ports are scrapped locally and are not returned. Kit lead time is eight weeks and inlets are not available as loose spares until 2021.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 24 months of the date of this Service Bulletin.
